articles.title: Curtiss-Wright (CW) Just Raised Guidance Again, So What’s The Catch?
articles.summary: Defence and aerospace firm Curtiss-Wright reported its Q2 2026 earnings, with sales rising 5% year-over-year to $924 million. While demonstrating solid revenue growth, the company noted that underlying financial and operational specifics were the 'real story,' indicating a more comprehensive performance analysis beyond the reported sales figures.

articles.title: Miami Dolphins' Jeff Hafley: 'People are so quick to judge' rookies
articles.summary: Jeff Hafley, the new head coach for the Miami Dolphins, recently debuted in his first preseason game. Having just arrived in South Florida, he quickly perceived the region's strong expectation for immediate results and its lack of patience. This early observation highlights the immense pressure on new coaches in professional sports, even after just one initial game.

articles.title: Miami Dolphins' Jeff Hafley: Quinn Ewers was off, but so were others
articles.summary: Miami Dolphins coach Jeff Hafley publicly defended backup quarterback Quinn Ewers following a challenging preseason debut. Hafley aimed to alleviate pressure on Ewers, whose initial performance garnered significant attention. The coach's supportive remarks sought to manage expectations and provide reassurance to the young quarterback early in the season, highlighting the team's commitment to his development.

articles.title: Lanterns Composer Discusses Distinguishing Hal & John, Grounded Themes
articles.summary: Composer Stephanie Economou, known for Jupiter's Legacy, recently discussed her work on the score for the upcoming "Lanterns" project. She elaborated on how 'Rock' served as a key inspiration for the music and delved into crafting distinct themes for characters Jordan and Stewart, offering insight into the creative process for the anticipated HBO/TV series.

articles.title: Qatar denies it is detaining three Iranian bomber pilots
articles.summary: Qatar's Foreign Ministry has denied Iran's claims regarding the secret detention of three Iranian pilots. Iran alleged its pilots were held after their aircraft was downed during hostilities earlier this year. Qatar refutes these accusations, stating no such individuals are in their custody. This diplomatic exchange highlights ongoing tensions and disputes between the two nations concerning the aftermath of previous military engagements.

articles.title: ‘Lanterns’ Bosses and Stars on How the Show’s Grounded Approach Ushers in an ‘Entirely Different Kind of Superhero’
articles.summary: James Gunn and Peter Safran's revamped DCU is developing a more grounded 'Green Lantern' project, moving away from previous film interpretations like the Ryan Reynolds version. This new approach aims to deeply integrate the iconic superhero into the expanded DC universe. Aspirants can observe how major franchises undergo strategic re-evaluation for fresh narratives and cohesive universe-building, reflecting adaptive planning in creative industries.

articles.title: BJP’s Nainar Nagenthran courts controversy with remarks against Tamil Nadu CM Vijay
articles.summary: Saba Ali Pataudi recently recalled her mother, Sharmila Tagore's, conversion to Islam after marrying Mansoor Ali Khan Pataudi (Tiger Pataudi).
